g.text: Monomer refolding supports compatibility with the design backbone
Matched backbones only; each point averages designs within one backbone. This comparison does not test binding.
Black bars are challenge-weighted means. Symbols identify challenges 1 (circle), 2 (square), 3 (triangle) and 5 (diamond).
